name: WaterYouDoin
tagline: A browser extension that checks prompts locally and redirects, blocks or nudges low-value AI requests.
problem: Developers send AI assistants requests that do not need AI, such as definitions or repeated prompts.
solution: Classifies prompts on the device before sending: factual ones go to a normal search engine, low-value ones are blocked, and reasoning-heavy ones get a nudge to think first, with a visual summary.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask a definition and get sent to a search engine instead.

why_it_stood_out.claim: All decisions happen locally, without judging the user.
Placed second with no LLM in the loop.

lessons: An anti-AI-waste tool that itself avoids AI is a memorable twist.
